summary: GeneWeb is a genealogy application designed to manage family trees and historical lineage data. It can operate entirely offline or function as a web service to allow remote access and collaborative editing. Developed using OCaml, it processes genealogical records and generates web interfaces for viewing family connections.
goodFor: Self-hosters looking for a dedicated genealogy tool to manage extensive family trees privately on their own hardware.
watchOut: The OCaml ecosystem has a smaller user base than Python or Node.js stacks, which may make customisation or troubleshooting more challenging for administrators unfamiliar with the language.
deployNotes: You will typically need to configure persistent storage for your family tree data and place the service behind a reverse proxy to handle TLS termination securely.
